name: Distance-Cube Polynomial Characterizes Rooted Daisy Cubes
statement: For a partial cube $G$ rooted at $u$, the following are equivalent: $G$ is a daisy cube rooted at $u$; $C(G,x)=W_{G,u}(x+1)$; $D_{G,u}(x,y)=W_{G,u}(x+y)$; and $D_{G,u}(x,y)=C(G,x+y-1)$. Every rooted partial cube satisfies $D_{G,u}(x,y)\le W_{G,u}(x+y)$ coefficientwise, with equality exactly in the daisy case.
comments: The cited source is a March 2026 arXiv preprint; that publication status is preserved.
